g.text: The firmware is used as it is. Cameras and anything about vision are Leo's (TBD Leo).
an NFC tap on the band opens the web
everything in a lite band, plus an
MPU-6050 IMU for fall detection and a
Station markers x2 to 5, at the
ESP32-C3 SuperMini and a spare LED
zones and glow their exit colour
XIAO ESP32-C3 on USB, id 200; one
JSON line per packet; sends each
Overhead phone camera on a stand
On the band, with no server
Counts the bands it hears and turns that into a green, yellow or red ring.
Its zone is the station marker it hears loudest; a band never knows a position.
SOS or a fall: its ring strobes red and the bands close by pulse blue.
Guidance: the band shows the colour of the nearest exit's marker, and the full bands vibrate to move people along the dispersion route.
